# Resource: widget_gadget_part

A part attached to a gadget.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "widget_gadget" "main" {
  name = "Main"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `gadget` - (Required) The ID of the parent object.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.

## Import

The ID is the gadget ID and the part ID, separated by a slash.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a widget gadget part using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = widget_gadget_part.main
  id = "gad_123/part_456"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = widget_gadget_part.main
  identity = {
    gadget = "gad_123"
    id     = "part_456"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `gadget` (String) The ID of the parent gadget.
* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the widget gadget part.

Using `terraform import`, import a widget gadget part using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import widget_gadget_part.main gad_123/part_456
```

-> Parts are matched by serial.
